findings.motion: HB 26, Voter identification; accepted forms of identification, private entities licensed or certified, Senate passage (21-Y 17-N); she is listed among the YEAS
findings.note: Bill adds to the accepted voter IDs a photo ID card issued by a private entity licensed or certified by certain state health and social services agencies. Vetoed by the Governor 2024-04-08; House sustained the veto 2024-04-17.

findings.motion: SB 52, Voter registration; regular periodic review of registration records, Senate passage (21-Y 19-N); she is listed among the YES votes
findings.note: Bill on regular periodic review of voter registration records (voter-roll upkeep). Passed the Senate on 2026-02-02; last action on the tracker is House, Left in Appropriations, 2026-03-10. Official vote page https://lis.virginia.gov/vote-details/20261/SB52/VSV156 could not be read.
